text:
I'll capture a calibrated snapshot of both cameras so I can localize the puck and goal.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "capture_scene", "arguments": {"cameras": ["corner", "topview"]}}]}
```

The puck is at about (-0.019, 0.675, 0.02) and the goal at (-0.023, 0.879, 0.021), so the push direction is +y. I need the initial orientation in roll-pitch-yaw to keep it fixed during moves.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "python", "arguments": {"code": "print(quaternion_to_rpy([0.704843200226324,0.006447860918578087,0.7093191784507314,-0.0045597441011812085]))"}}]}
```

The initial orientation is roll 2.7502, pitch 1.5639, yaw 2.7346. I'll first move the gripper above the point behind the puck, keeping that orientation and closing the gripper for pushing.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.019, 0.61, 0.10, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The hand reached the staging point (z≈0.129, within tolerance). Next I'll lower it to pad height behind the puck, keeping the orientation.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.019, 0.61, 0.03, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The hand stopped at z≈0.059, near the edge of the standard tolerance. That is too high to push the puck cleanly, so I'll re-run the lowering with the precision profile.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "precision", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.019, 0.61, 0.03, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 24, "position_tolerance_m": 0.005}}]}
```

The hand stalled at z≈0.046, which looks like the workspace floor for this arm. At that height the finger pads should sit at puck level, so I'll push along +y at this height, aiming past the goal at y=0.90.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.019, 0.90, 0.046, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The push ran out of steps at y≈0.707, and the puck is no longer visible in the corner view. I'll capture both cameras to see where it went before deciding the next move.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "capture_scene", "arguments": {"cameras": ["corner", "topview"]}}]}
```

The puck is not visible in the topview, so it is probably hidden under the hand, which sits near pixel row 103. I'll lift the hand straight up and then capture a fresh view to find the puck.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.016, 0.707, 0.15, 1.93323, 1.50766, 1.94692], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 12}}, {"name": "capture_scene", "arguments": {"cameras": ["corner", "topview"]}}]}
```

The move was rejected because I passed the wrong orientation. The backend requires the initial quaternion, which is the roll-pitch-yaw I used before. I'll retry the lift with that orientation and capture again.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.016, 0.707, 0.15, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 12}}, {"name": "capture_scene", "arguments": {"cameras": ["corner", "topview"]}}]}
```

The puck is still not visible in the topview, and the arm may be covering it. I'll move the hand well clear of the table area toward the side, keeping the initial orientation, and then capture the scene again.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [0.12, 0.55, 0.20, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 24}}, {"name": "capture_scene", "arguments": {"cameras": ["corner", "topview"]}}]}
```

The puck is now visible in the topview as the dark red dot near pixel (row 93, col 157), and it appears to have been pushed toward the goal. I'll triangulate it from both views to get its exact position.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "locate", "arguments": {"method": "triangulate", "snapshot_id": "15bce872c396487e39d36d1f73c6168aec522c991eb9d98e431efeeb5d609e99", "observations": [{"camera": "corner", "pixel": [130, 170]}, {"camera": "topview", "pixel": [93, 157]}]}}]}
```

The puck is at about (-0.010, 0.756, 0.015), and the goal is at (-0.023, 0.879, 0.021). I'll bring the hand above the puck's rear side at y≈0.70, then lower it for the push.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.01, 0.70, 0.12, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The hand is now about 0.07 m behind the puck and at the intended height. Next I'll lower it to push height at the same position.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.01, 0.68, 0.046, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The hand reached a z of 0.072, which is within tolerance but high. I'll try a precision move down to z=0.05 before pushing.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "precision", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.01, 0.68, 0.05, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 12, "position_tolerance_m": 0.01}}]}
```

The hand is at z≈0.059, about 0.10 m behind the puck. I'll push along +y toward the goal, holding the orientation.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.01, 0.92, 0.05, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The hand traveled to y≈0.756 and the puck is no longer visible in the corner view. I'll capture both cameras to see where the puck went.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "capture_scene", "arguments": {"cameras": ["corner", "topview"]}}]}
```

The puck is hidden under the hand in both views. I'll lift the hand straight up and capture again to find it.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.007, 0.72, 0.18, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 16}}, {"name": "capture_scene", "arguments": {"cameras": ["corner", "topview"]}}]}
```

The puck is now at about (-0.004, 0.803, 0.015), roughly 0.08 m short of the goal. I'll lower the hand behind the puck at y≈0.745, keeping the orientation.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.008, 0.745, 0.05, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The lowering stalled at z≈0.154, so the hand is not descending. I'll try a shorter intermediate target first at z=0.09, slightly behind the puck.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.008, 0.72, 0.09, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```

The hand reached z≈0.114 against a commanded 0.09, so the standard tolerance is hiding a height shortfall. I'll use the precision profile to lower to z=0.06 at the same spot.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "precision", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.008, 0.72, 0.06, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 20, "position_tolerance_m": 0.01}}]}
```

The hand is at z≈0.063 and about 0.075 m behind the puck. I'll push along +y at this height, aiming past the goal at y=0.93.

```json
{"calls": [{"name": "move", "arguments": {"profile": "standard", "targets": [{"arm": "arm", "pose": [-0.008, 0.93, 0.063, 2.75019093, 1.56392618, 2.73462358], "gripper": 0}], "max_steps": 24}}]}
```
